plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: Live pane of the current request: % complete, tokens and what each agent and subagent is doing, with a pixel Claude per agent dressed for its job

plugins.name: bat-flyby
plugins.description: A Dracula bat flies across the band above the prompt whenever a git push succeeds

plugins.name: chat-blame
plugins.description: Records which chat (session) last edited each file, so git-panel can badge every change with the chat it came from

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context usage bar above the prompt: 1M scale, 300k marker, green under / orange over

plugins.name: dracula-skin
plugins.description: Dracula skin for desktop and VS Code: turn dividers, tree-line tool rows with [tags], light/dark palette, and a banner at session start

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

plugins.name: git-panel
plugins.description: Git side pane: diffs of every changed file, branch ahead/behind, stage/commit/push/pull/stash, and git worktree management

plugins.name: lockstep-guards
plugins.description: Flags .env/.env.example drift and schema/types/Zod changes that aren't in lockstep

plugins.name: pb-light
plugins.description: Status-line light: is live PocketBase in sync with the repo pb_schema.json (read-only check)

plugins.name: unshipped-nag
plugins.description: Toast after a turn when changes sit uncommitted for 30+ min or commits are not pushed (at most every 30 min)

plugins.name: win-jar
plugins.description: Collects every finished step from all chats into a shipped-today jar: /wins pane, streaks, a toast per win
